title: Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Ada bar Ahavah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Kohelet Rabbah 1:5 says that he was born on the day his father died, and when he died his son Rabbi Avin was born. Hyman says it is known that the text of this statement has become corrupted.[^1]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah–TE text of Kohelet Rabbah 1:5 explicitly names Rav Ada bar Ahavah, his son Rav Hamnuna, and the latter’s son Rabbi Avin in this birth-and-death sequence. The assertion that its wording is corrupt remains Hyman’s judgment, not an emendation adopted here.
